why: B follows the Nordic light-wood brief more closely: a light ash desk, a birch rocking armchair and a reading lamp suited to the task. Its bookcase is a bit oversized and the honey-toned chair is not an exact match, but the whole reads as one coherent look. A mixes dark metal and espresso pieces with a gray mesh chair and a spotlight lamp, so the look is disjointed and less Nordic, and the lamp and lounge chair are poorly suited to reading.
